title: Datalchemy
summary: Datalchemy is a Python library for generating synthetic relational-database data, primarily via LLM-driven prompts, aimed at prototyping, teaching, and small-scale testing of SQL-backed applications. A test/sample script in the repo imports SDV's HMASynthesizer and MultiTableMetadata and fits it against sample multi-table data, apparently as an alternate or precursor generation approach to the LLM pipeline.
needs: Unclear whether the SDV sample script reflects a core, currently-used feature or a leftover/legacy experiment, since the README's described generation mechanism is LLM-based, not SDV.
